items.description: Recovery incl. locksmith call-out and cutting seized lock
items.rationale: Recovery costs under 5.2.2 (attendance, cutting lock) are covered but bundled with repair inside the EUR 500 aggregate mobility sub-limit (4.2.2), shared rateably with lines 2-3.

items.description: Repair theft damage to bicycle (frame and brakes)
items.rationale: Damage found on recovered item is covered under 2.3.1(b)/7.1.1(b), but the aggregate EUR 500 sub-limit for mobility equipment applies rateably; this is likely the largest share.
Labour and sundries serving the covered repair are part of repair cost (7.1.7 d,e), subject to the shared EUR 500 sub-limit rateably.
